tagline: STIHL outdoor equipment for Te Aro homes and gardens
heroSubheading: We stock, service and support STIHL outdoor power equipment for local gardens and properties.
aboutHtml:
Richard and Gina Lousley run STIHL SHOP Te Aro, your local STIHL stockist. We stock a full range of outdoor power equipment: chainsaws, hedge trimmers, brushcutters, garden tools and more for gardens and small properties around Te Aro.

We don't just sell equipment. We service what we sell, keep spare parts in stock, and give honest advice to help you choose the right tool for the job. If something needs repair, we can help with that too.

Locals come to us because we understand STIHL equipment and we stand behind every sale. Come in and have a look. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and Saturday to Sunday 9am to 3pm.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Full STIHL range and genuine spare parts
servicesIntro: Our workshop handles servicing and repairs for all STIHL equipment, keeping your tools ready to work.
